schema_note: D1 draft, ROUTE: draft. One entry per taxonomy plus a cross_taxonomy_links inventory. Facts only from scout inventory + repo config reads; every unknown is null with a specific null_reason.

node_count_by_level.theme_null_reason: top-level theme count not separately given in scout pass — only the leaf-level 'subthemes' count is published in data/theme_graph/_meta.json

taxonomies.native_id_type: finviz 'theme'/'subsector' string label (vendor webpack data chunk); minted into theme_graph as ltheme:finviz:* node ids
taxonomies.native_id_example_null_reason: no example label captured verbatim in scout pass

membership_semantics.multi_label_null_reason: whether a single ticker can carry multiple finviz subthemes not confirmed in scout pass

taxonomies.hierarchy_note: single flat theme level; themes carry OUTBOUND link fields into other taxonomies rather than owning internal sub-levels (see cross_taxonomy_links)
taxonomies.native_id_example_null_reason: no example id captured verbatim in scout pass

membership_semantics.multi_label_note: basket_ids is a list field per theme row (02_theme_crosswalk.md)

citrini_basket_ids (list; always [] on every row v1-v3, reserved not populated)
theme_node_id ('theme:<slug>', v3 join key into data/theme_graph/nodes.parquet)
ths_concept_ids (list of THS numeric board codes, v3)
cn_basket_ids (list, v3, CN half of crosswalk)

membership_semantics.multi_label_null_reason: cross-basket ticker multiplicity not enumerated in scout pass
membership_semantics.weights_available_null_reason: membership.json weighting scheme (equal vs weighted) not read in scout pass

taxonomies.levels_null_reason: node/edge KIND enum (e.g. company node vs theme node vs local-theme node; membership edge vs expresses edge) not captured verbatim in scout pass — _meta.json gives aggregate counts only, no kind-level breakdown was read from nodes.parquet/edges.parquet themselves
taxonomies.hierarchy_depth_null_reason: graph is a node/edge join hub, not a strict level hierarchy; not characterized as such in scout pass
taxonomies.native_id_type: theme_node_id 'theme:<slug>' join key (theme nodes); company nodes presumably ticker-keyed via engine/theme_graph/identity.py — not independently confirmed in scout pass
taxonomies.native_id_example: theme:<slug> (literal placeholder syntax as documented; no concrete example slug captured in scout pass)
taxonomies.member_identity_grain_null_reason: not characterized at node-kind level in scout pass

clocks.note: two distinct clocks: belief_time = observed-era PIT belief date; computed_at = build clock

taxonomies.taxonomy_name: Structural sector/industry classification (us_sector_* pseudo-baskets + config/sector_legs.json + board-row 'sector' field)
taxonomies.hierarchy_depth_null_reason: no per-ticker GICS/SIC/NAICS code table found by name anywhere in the repo at this pin (07_gics_sector.md); true GICS sector->industry->sub-industry depth not confirmed as implemented here

membership_semantics.multi_label_note: sector_legs.json registers each ticker to ONE leg even where it structurally spans GICS sectors (header note: mag7 spans XLC/XLY but registered as XLK leg)

additional_surfaces: config/sector_legs.json (version 1.0, registered 2026-07-12) — hand-declared primary/secondary tier sector-leg mapping, explicitly a rotation-command convenience mapping, documents its own departure from strict GICS

engine/us_context_vector.py:968/1154/1258 — individual company 'sector' string field rides on board-row metadata, sourced from upstream `meta`, not traced further (likely a market-data vendor field, out of scope this pass)

cross_taxonomy_links.count_split_by_source_null_reason: data/theme_graph/_meta.json per_suite.crosswalk.local_theme_expresses_edges=61 is a combined figure; per-source (finviz vs ths) split not given in scout pass

cross_taxonomy_links.description: the field set on each crosswalk_theme row that performs the cross-taxonomy joins
